title: 第三位客人

series.next: You wake at your desk. 11:40 pm, 除夕. Twenty minutes to midnight.

setting: The office, the small hours of 除夕 night. The lift is humming upward. The third visitor doesn't speak.

steps.narr: Last time, the visitor took you home. You keep seeing that one clean pair of chopsticks.

else.narr: The last thing you remember is 弟弟's glass of orange juice, raised to you.

steps.narr: The lift doors open by themselves. Inside: a tall figure in a long grey coat, its face hidden under a hood. It says nothing.
It points at your phone. The date on the screen flickers, and changes: next year's 除夕.

say.en: Ask the silent visitor: is this next year's 除夕?
say.gloss: Is this next year's 除夕?
say.tip: 明年 míngnián = next year. 的 joins it to 除夕: next year's 除夕.

ok.narr: It nods, once. The office is gone.

fail.narr: The visitor waits. It has all the time in the world.

answers: 你要带我去看明年的除夕吗？
4.gloss: You're taking me to see next year's 除夕?

steps.narr: Your parents' flat, next year. The gala on, the sound off. Two bowls on the table. Two pairs of chopsticks.

steps.en: Our child isn't coming this year either.
No more setting the bowl. What's the use.

steps.narr: There's no third bowl. There's no third chair either. Someone has moved it to the balcony.

say.en: Plead with the visitor: is there still time?
say.tip: 来得及 = there's time (to do it). 来不及 = too late.

ok.narr: The visitor says nothing. It only points again, somewhere else.

answers: 告诉我，现在还来得及吗？
4.gloss: Tell me: is there still time?

steps.narr: Your office, next year. 小葛's desk is bare, her nameplate gone. A sticky note on the screen.
steps.zh: 我回老家了。祝您新年快乐。小葛

steps.narr: On your desk, your phone rings. And rings. The screen says who it is.
Nobody is there to answer it. Nobody has been there for a long time.

say.gloss: I'll change. I promise I'll change.
say.tip: 一定 yídìng = definitely: 一定改 = I will change, for sure.

ok.narr: The visitor lowers its hand, and for the first time, holds something out to you: your own phone.

answers: 我改，从今天开始，我一定改。
4.gloss: I'll change. From today on, I'll change.

say.en: Go home now, or call your mum first.
say.tip: 现在就 = right now: 就 says no waiting.

ok.narr: The visitor nods. Everything goes white.

then.narr: You press call. It rings once. Then everything goes white.

fail.narr: The visitor waits, holding out the phone.

4.gloss: No more waiting. I'm going home right now.

answers: 等一下，我要先给我妈打个电话。
alts.gloss: Wait. First I'm going to call my mum.

steps.en: You wake at your desk. 11:40 pm, 除夕. You're already putting on your coat. 🕯️

else.en: You wake at your desk. 11:40 pm, 除夕. Your phone is in your hand, and it's ringing out. 🕯️
